name: herdr-dispatch
description: Dispatch tasks to codex / grok / opencode / cursor / devin agents running in isolated herdr worktrees, supervise them to completion, then push each lane and open its pull request

hooks.command: for v in "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/herdr-dispatch/herdr-dispatch/*/skills; do [ -d "$v/_shared" ] || continue; for r in "$v"/dispatch-*/references; do cp "$v/_shared/plan.md" "$v/_shared/supervise.md" "$r/" 2>/dev/null; done; done; exit 0
